modes.always: Always optimize unless bypassed with !raw or [RAW] tags
modes.opt-in: Only optimize when prompt starts with !! or !opt
modes.opt-out: Optimize by default, skip with !skip or !noopt
modes.disabled: Never optimize (hook still runs but passes through)

description: Configure prompt optimizer behavior. Change 'mode' to one of: always, opt-in, opt-out, disabled
